v2-directed-current.description: Mirrors the lamp-live directed policy at source 64529dee: every detected speech run is admitted and cancels any current reply. There is no addressee, acknowledgment or echo gate. Echo is cancelled perfectly in this profile.

v2-echo-leak-h4.description: Same policy with one injected residual-echo burst 846 ms after the first accepted reply write, the admission timing observed in physical trial h4jds57i. This is fault injection, not an echo model.

v2-echo-loop.description: Same policy with a residual-echo burst 600 ms after every reply's first write, so each spurious turn's answer can trigger the next. Reproduces the self-sustaining admission chain seen in zejfwxq7 (four admissions from one question). Fault injection, not an echo model.

scenarios.description: Two asides early in a long story each yield and resume; a real request 25 s after the second must still cut in.

steps.reference: Starts a story of about a minute; it is expected to be cut in on late.
The asides yield and resume (two fruitless yields); 25 s on they are forgiven, so the story yields to the request and answers 56.

scenarios.description: Two asides early in a long story each yield and resume; a real request 10 s after the second is inside the 20 s, so the story goes on.

steps.reference: Tells the whole story of about a minute.
